John Doggett.

Utah? What are you doing there?

Dana Scully

The, uh, local coroner wants a consultation on a murder victim.... A man who was found beaten to death in the desert. Apparently, his corpse shows some anomalous characteristics.

John Doggett

Anomalous? How?

Dana Scully

From what they're telling me, he is a 22-year-old backpacker who was last seen by his family about six months ago in perfect health. However, his body is now showing advanced signs of osteoporosis arthritis and kyphosis of the vertebrae. In other words, he's got a spine of a 90-year-old woman.

John Doggett

Sounds anomalous, all right. You didn't need me to tag along?

Dana Scully

Well, actually, there might be, if you don't mind. Somewhere in our files... There is a, uh, an unsolved murder case. Unfortunately, I, uh, don't remember any of the particulars like where or when it took place but I do remember that there were some glycoproteins found at the crime scene.

John Doggett

"glycoproteins."

Dana Scully

Yeah, mucous... But it was, uh, unable to be identified, and seeing as how you, uh, recently read through all of our files I thought maybe it would ring a bell with you.

Dana Scully
